label: buff
design: University of Colorado palette — CU gold (#CFB87C) on black and white. Gold is structural, not decorative: it draws the rules, the meta bar, and the callout edge. Black section heads, generous white. Restrained; it should read as institutional, not as spirit wear.
language: Institutional and plain. Name the stakes in money or people, not adjectives. Higher-ed readers are sceptical of vendor voice — describe what happened, let it land.
note: Evokes the client's palette on a case study about their work. Does not use their marks, seal, or wordmark, and the page carries Alex's own masthead throughout. Single-scheme on purpose. CU gold and black is an institutional palette with no dark variant, and inventing one would be inventing the client.
